operator: Cpl Tremain A. Wade Jr., USMC (Ret.)

cards.why_matters: Central operating system for all life branches — knowledge vault, automation hub, dashboard. Without it, all systems are scattered.
cards.minimum_viable_version: Single-page dashboard with 8 branch tabs, searchable prompt vault, tracker view. No export yet.
cards.resources_needed: Python (Flask/FastAPI), Postgres, React or HTML5, ~40 hrs dev
cards.first_action: Create clickable wireframe (Figma), define data schema, build first 3 screens
cards.risk: Scope creep, complexity explosion. Mitigation: rigid MVP deadline (2 weeks).

cards.why_matters: Merge manuscript, CS curriculum, and accessible narrative game. Opens teaching/story IP channel. Feeds app GUI.
cards.minimum_viable_version: Story of Pi Chapters I-III + 3 CodeQuest game screens. Proof narrative can become interactive.
cards.resources_needed: Story chapters (5K words), game wireframes, character sprites, ~60 hrs design/dev
cards.first_action: Index all available manuscript fragments, create scene-to-screen map for Ch. I, prototype first game screen
cards.risk: Scope explosion (full game impossible in 2 weeks). Mitigation: lock scope to 3 scenes.

cards.why_matters: Physical infrastructure for accessibility, work-from-home autonomy, and guest space. Proves concepts can be built.
cards.minimum_viable_version: Design doc: shower accessibility, office/studio layout, accessible kitchen. Blueprint for one room.
cards.resources_needed: Architect consultation, accessibility code research, contractor estimates, ~30 hrs research + design
cards.first_action: Audit current home for accessibility barriers, sketch futuristic shower concept, find VA accessibility grants
cards.risk: High cost. Mitigation: phase into annual budget, start with one room.

cards.why_matters: Multi-unit property as financial stabilizer, family gathering space, and VA community hub. Long-term wealth + purpose.
cards.minimum_viable_version: Property checklist + zone map. Identify 5 candidate properties. Pre-approval for loan.
cards.resources_needed: Real estate agent, VA appraiser, loan pre-qual, market research (VA market, land), ~50 hrs research
cards.first_action: List criteria (acreage, accessibility, proximity to VA, cost), search Zillow/MLS, schedule 3 property tours
cards.risk: Market volatility, financing. Mitigation: buy signals + 18-month timeline.

cards.why_matters: Faceless content automation = recurring revenue stream. Feeds Story of Pi game, app tutorials, and lead magnets.
cards.minimum_viable_version: First 90-day sprint: 3 faceless content pipelines (video scripting, blog + SEO, email sequences). One goes live.
cards.resources_needed: Content templates, API keys (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, video API), ~80 hrs build + testing
cards.first_action: Map 3 content types, pick easiest one (email sequences), build first 5-message automation, run test campaign
cards.risk: Quality control + brand risk. Mitigation: human review on every output, start hidden.

cards.why_matters: Distill lived experience + author research into coherent doctrine. Feeds coaching, app tutorials, and teaching IP.
cards.minimum_viable_version: Thesis outline + 3 deep-dive chapters (Decision-Making, Resilience, Service). Source matrix.
cards.resources_needed: Author research, writing (10K words), interviews, ~60 hrs writing + synthesis
cards.first_action: List 5 leadership authors to integrate, outline thesis structure (5 chapters), write Chapter 1 (Decision-Making)
cards.risk: Over-theorizing. Mitigation: anchor every point in lived Marine/Primerica example.

cards.why_matters: Spanish/French/Bemba fluency = access to global markets + cultural depth. Feeds app, content, and personal mastery.
cards.minimum_viable_version: Daily drill template + 30-day Spanish sprint (vocabulary + conversation). Shared deck format.
cards.resources_needed: Duolingo Pro, Anki, iTalki tutor (2 hrs/week), content creation, ~20 hrs setup
cards.first_action: Create Anki deck (100 core Spanish phrases), schedule 2 iTalki lessons, build first 5-day drill sequence
cards.risk: Inconsistent practice. Mitigation: daily app notification + public accountability.

cards.why_matters: Physical autonomy = independence. Feeds real estate design, app accessibility, and personal quality of life.
cards.minimum_viable_version: Health audit (PT assessment, mobility checklist), equipment list, 3-month protocol. Accessibility modifications for home.
cards.resources_needed: PT evaluation, adaptive equipment, research, ~25 hrs assessment + shopping
cards.first_action: Schedule VA PT eval, take mobility baseline (flexibility/strength), list 5 adaptive tools to trial
cards.risk: Overextension. Mitigation: focus on top-3 barriers, work with PT to sequence.
